title: Celestin, Sharkey and George Lewis unphotographed; losing interest in Sharkey's band
summary: He did not photograph Celestin, Sharkey or George Lewis on Bourbon Street. He first heard Sharkey's band in 1947 but lost interest once they played the same things nightly.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left
